messages.content: Help me come up with a silly superhero whose power is related to office supplies.

I love this! Let me brainstorm a few options:

**The Binder Clip** - Can compress anything to a fraction of its size temporarily, but leaves characteristic ridged marks. Costume features those little metal wings that flip up. Catchphrase: "Time to keep things together!"

**Post-It Pat** - Leaves adhesive reminder notes on villains that they physically cannot ignore. The notes stick to their consciousness until they complete the task. Minor power: can reposition anything once without consequence.

**Correcto, the White-Out Warrior** - Can erase small mistakes from reality, but it takes ages to dry and everything stops working until it does. Leaves suspicious white patches everywhere. Weakness: cannot erase mistakes made with pen (only pencil crimes).

**The Stapler** (arch-nemesis: The Staple Remover) - Binds things together with surprising strength, but has to reload at dramatic moments. Has an intimidating *ka-CHUNK* sound effect. Special move: "The Jam" - gets stuck and completely useless until someone helps them.

My favorite might be **Correcto** - I'm imagining them dramatically waving their correction fluid dispenser, time freezing while white liquid agonizingly covers a villain's evil plan, everyone just... waiting... tapping their feet... "Is it dry yet?" "Don't touch it!" "You smudged it, now we have to start over!"

Which vibe appeals to you most? I can develop any of these further!
Correcto is hilarious! Can you write a dramatic scene where Correcto faces their arch-nemesis?

**CORRECTO vs. THE PERMANENT MARKER: A TALE OF INDELIBLE EVIL**

---

Thunder cracked over City Hall as Correcto burst through the doors, their white cape billowing heroically. There, hunched over the original Constitution display case, was a figure in a black suit with an uncapped felt tip gleaming menacingly.

"Permanent Marker," Correcto breathed. "Step away from the document."

The villain turned slowly, revealing a face marked with streaks of black ink. "Ah, Correcto. Come to... *erase* me from history?" They cackled at their own pun. "Too late! I've already signed my name across the Bill of Rights! In PERMANENT INK!"

"No!" Correcto reached for their utility belt, fingers closing around the cold dispenser. "Your vandalism ends here!"

"Does it?" Permanent Marker sneered, holding up their marker—a Sharpie Magnum, the worst kind. "We both know the truth. You can cover my work, but underneath?" They leaned in close. "I'll always be there. Faintly visible. A shadow of wrongdoing you can never truly eliminate."

Correcto's hand trembled. It was true. White-out over permanent marker was... imperfect at best.

"Plus," Permanent Marker added with devastating casualness, "how long will it take your precious fluid to dry? Five minutes? Ten? Can this city afford to wait while you perform your little cover-up?"

The Constitution sat between them, already defaced with "PERMANENT MARKER WUZ HERE" in bold strokes.

Correcto raised their dispenser anyway. "Some mistakes take longer to fix than others. But that doesn't mean we give up." They pressed the applicator. "We just need... more... coats..."

White fluid began its agonizingly slow coverage.

"NOOOO!" screamed Permanent Marker. "Not... the multiple applications! My one weakness—patience and determination!"

"That's two weaknesses," Correcto noted, applying another careful layer.

"Still drying from the first coat!"

"I know. We're going to be here a while."

They locked eyes across the display case. The clock ticked. The white-out glistened wetly.

Someone in the doorway whispered: "Should we... do something?"

"Shhh," said the police chief. "Don't smudge it."

---

*Will the document be saved? Will it ever truly dry? Will there be a weird bumpy texture forever? Find out next time on: CORRECTO, THE WHITE-OUT WARRIOR!*
